2026 Skoda Slavia facelift review: we drive the updated Slavia with the new 8-speed automatic and find out why the sedan still makes a strong case in a market full of SUVs.
Skoda entered India 25 years ago with a sedan, and the first-generation Octavia built the brand's reputation here. With the Octavia now sold only as the pricey RS, the Slavia carries that idea forward as the affordable Skoda sedan for enthusiasts.
